items.title: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) Deepens Its Role In Navy Electronic Warfare Program
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) awarded Marotta Controls a contract to support the U.S. Navy's Next Generation Jammer, Low Band program for airborne electronic warfare. The agreement centers on critical hardware for the NGJ-LB pod that will equip Navy aircraft with advanced jamming capability. The contract adds to L3Harris Technologies' role as prime contractor on NGJ-LB and contributes to its long-term government project pipeline. Defense related electronic systems are drawing wider...

items.title: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) On CEO Exit The Bull Case Still Points To Undervaluation
items.summary: L3Harris Technologies (LHX) is in focus after law firm Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman began investigating potential securities claims following CEO Christopher Kubasik’s August 17 resignation for conduct inconsistent with company values. L3Harris Technologies’ share price has softened recently, with a 30-day share price return down 4.87% and a year to date share price return down 13.44%, even though the 3-year total shareholder return of 61.12% points to stronger long term compounding. items.title: NASA Is About to Launch a Telescope. What That Means for SpaceX, Others.
items.summary: Space is recapturing Americans’ imagination, mainly thanks to  SpaceX  Elon Musk, and his trillion-dollar dreams to make humans a multi-planetary species.  There’s more to space than just SpaceX, which will benefit other shares beyond Musk’s rocket and AI company.  On Sunday, NASA is scheduled to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.

items.title: CEO Exit Leaves L3Harris Stock in the Discount Bin
items.summary: L3Harris shares are down roughly 11% this year, lagging other big U.S. defense companies. The abrupt exit of CEO Christopher Kubasik after a probe into allegations of inappropriate conduct with a subordinate has weighed on the stock, which now looks like a cheap way to bet on missile rearmament.
